mapper.select: INSERT INTO iam_signing_keys (kid, key_version_reference, public_jwk_modulus, public_jwk_exponent, key_status, published_at, activated_at, retire_after, retired_at, revoked_at) VALUES (#{row.kid}, #{row.keyVersionReference}, #{row.publicJwkModulus}, #{row.publicJwkExponent}, #{row.keyStatus}, #{row.publishedAt}, #{row.activatedAt}, #{row.retireAfter}, #{row.retiredAt}, #{row.revokedAt}) RETURNING id, kid, key_version_reference, public_jwk_modulus, public_jwk_exponent, key_status, published_at, activated_at, retire_after, retired_at, revoked_at

SELECT id, kid, key_version_reference, public_jwk_modulus, public_jwk_exponent, key_status, published_at, activated_at, retire_after, retired_at, revoked_at FROM iam_signing_keys WHERE key_status = 'ACTIVE' ORDER BY kid

SELECT id, kid, key_version_reference, public_jwk_modulus, public_jwk_exponent, key_status, published_at, activated_at, retire_after, retired_at, revoked_at FROM iam_signing_keys WHERE key_status IN ('PUBLISHED', 'ACTIVE', 'RETIRING') ORDER BY published_at, kid

SELECT id, kid, key_version_reference, public_jwk_modulus, public_jwk_exponent, key_status, published_at, activated_at, retire_after, retired_at, revoked_at FROM iam_signing_keys WHERE id = #{keyId} FOR UPDATE

SELECT id, kid, key_version_reference, public_jwk_modulus, public_jwk_exponent, key_status, published_at, activated_at, retire_after, retired_at, revoked_at FROM iam_signing_keys WHERE key_status = 'ACTIVE' FOR UPDATE
mapper.update: UPDATE iam_signing_keys SET key_status = #{row.keyStatus}, published_at = #{row.publishedAt}, activated_at = #{row.activatedAt}, retire_after = #{row.retireAfter}, retired_at = #{row.retiredAt}, revoked_at = #{row.revokedAt} WHERE id = #{row.id}
